note: Font pairings: pick one with --fonts <name> (reel.cjs), FONTS=<name> (render.mjs) or "fonts": "<name>" in captions.js. Roles: display = hero words and titles, secondary = body words and pills, script = the one accent word per phrase (optional). Every file here is SIL OFL 1.1 from Google Fonts, committed unmodified with its OFL text. Your own licensed fonts (Druk, Helvetica...) go in kit/fonts/local/ with a kit/fonts/local/pairings.json in this same shape; that folder is gitignored and never committed. 'theme' keeps the theme's own fonts. lockup = how the two faces sit together in one title or caption: arrange stack|overlap|inline, partner script|secondary, scale = partner size / hero size (scriptBoost multiplies it for a script partner, whose small x-height reads smaller), partnerUpper/partnerTracking (em)/justify for tracked caps, anchor right|center and rotate (deg) and drop (partner baseline below the hero, in partner sizes) for overlap, heroColor/partnerColor accent|text|#hex.

modern.about: heavy caps grotesk + script tail overlapping its baseline (stand-in for a modern bold sans + Constane)

druk.about: WIDE heavy caps + a small tracked clean-sans caps line justified to it (free stand-in for Druk Wide + Helvetica)

elegant.about: classical serif caps + formal script crossing it (free stand-in for Optitimes + Sloop)

editorial.about: condensed serif italic hero + roman text serif support (free stand-in for Vanguard + Athelas)
